holds: INDEPENDENT_BACKUP: requires separately supplied authorized infrastructure; not satisfied by a local copy.
PRODUCTION_RTO: no host-disaster or production recovery-time objective is claimed.

nonClaims: No publication, private source, host admin, install-on-host, Docker socket, arbitrary shell capability or new platform.

fixed: AC02: readRestoredInstallationV1 observes the actual restored target (config/file digests, effect policy, writer authority, persisted installation state) read-only; the released doctor is fed the observed values and a READ/verified restoration is returned only on PASS + full match. Mutated/deleted config or file yields DENIED with an exact code and a non-PASS doctor.

AC04: diagnoseRecoveryV1 has a closed input shape; caller booleans are refused. VERIFIED_RESTORE is derived only from the independently re-checked native readback receipt; INDEPENDENT_BACKUP requires an INDEPENDENT_BACKUP manifest plus a source-bound destination receipt (never minted by this slice).
Guard: createPan462BackupV1/restorePan462BackupV1 prove an owned, disposable, distinct, non-symlink destination inside ownedRoot before any destructive rmSync.

followUp.finding: AC04 provenance bypass: exported diagnoseRecoveryV1 accepted a caller-self-rehashed restoreReadback as VERIFIED_RESTORE and a caller-self-rehashed destinationReceipt (with asserted independent/authorizedInfrastructure booleans) as INDEPENDENT_BACKUP, with no native readback and no authorized destination.
fixed: VERIFIED_RESTORE derives only from an issuer-bound native readback: the receipt is HMAC-sealed with a code-owned per-process issuer secret that only the actual native read path holds, and is bound to the material identity of one specific archive; a caller recomputing a plain sha256 cannot mint the seal.
INDEPENDENT_BACKUP is held: caller booleans, caller destination receipts and self-rehashes are never authority; the class is never minted in this slice.

Named negatives added: caller-self-rehashed readback (no VERIFIED_RESTORE), caller-self-rehashed destination receipt (no INDEPENDENT_BACKUP), genuine receipt replayed against a mismatched archive, modified observation, foreign issuer. Real native positive retained through the actual readback entry.
